# Purple8, Inc. (https://www.purple8.ai) - Official AI Agent & LLM Reference (llms.txt)

> **AI-Native Execution Infrastructure.**
> **Built for AI, Operated by AI and Supervised by Humans.**
> **Read · Remember · Reason · Answer · Run · Protect · Prove · One Engine built to solve complex problems.**

## 1. What Purple8 Is
Purple8, Inc. builds self-contained, AI-native execution infrastructure that replaces the fragmented 8 to 12 vendor AI stack (relational database, property/RDF graph database, vector database, document intelligence parser, RAG pipeline, stateful workflow orchestrator, auth/RBAC, KMS encryption, and SIEM/governance) with **one unified execution substrate** operated directly by AI agents over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and supervised by humans.

### Two Core Products
1. **Purple8 Hyper Graph (`v0.72.0`)** - Documentation: https://docs.graph.purple8.ai (`https://docs.graph.purple8.ai/llms.txt` · Discovery: `https://www.purple8.ai/.well-known/mcp.json`)
   - In-process multi-model execution engine: **Unified LPG (Labeled Property Graph / openCypher) + RDF (Semantic Triples / N-Quads) + Hypergraph + Temporal Graph**, Semantic Vector Search, Document & Structured Table Store, Full-Text Search, Self-Tuning Hybrid GraphRAG, Stateful Journey Workflows with SLAs & Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Gates, AEC/BIM Engineering, SOC & SuperGraph, Event Scheduler, Signed Webhooks, Quantum-Inspired QUBO Optimisation, 4-Tier RBAC, AES-256-GCM Envelope Encryption (Local/Vault/AWS/GCP/Azure KMS), and Autonomous SOC Containment.
   - Exposes **176 governed MCP tools across 19 namespaces** (`/mcp?profile=starter|builder|ops|full`).
2. **Purple8 DocIntel (`v0.12.5`)** - Documentation: https://docs.docintel.purple8.ai (`https://docs.docintel.purple8.ai/llms.txt`)
   - Universal document intelligence engine parsing **70+ document formats** (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, HTML, EML, IFC/BIM, DXF/DWG/STEP CAD, SAP IDoc, OCR images) across **75+ languages**.
   - Exposes 13 native MCP tools at `/mcp` and A2A 1.0 at `/a2a`.

---

## 2. The 3-Phase AI-Native Application Lifecycle (For AI Agents)

Full step-by-step blueprint: https://docs.graph.purple8.ai/guides/ai-agent-blueprint

### Phase 1 — Configure the Complete Backend Over MCP (Zero Server LLM or DocIntel Required)
When connected via MCP (`/mcp?profile=starter` [28 tools] or `/mcp?profile=builder` [117 tools]), **you (the AI agent) are the backend developer and reasoning engine**. You do **not** need a server-side LLM key or DocIntel configured to build or operate the backend:
- **Schema (`schema.*`):** `schema.define_node_type`, `schema.define_edge_type`, `schema.validate` (supports `string`, `integer`, `float`/`number`, `boolean`, `datetime`, `list`/`array`, `dict`/`object`).
- **Unified LPG + RDF on a Single Instance (`graph.*`):**
  - Use **LPG** (`graph.add_node`, `graph.add_edge`) for operational entities, mutable state, and vector embeddings. *(Note: `graph.add_node` takes `type` as a singular string, not `labels` list.)*
  - Use **RDF** (`graph.assert_statement`, `graph.import_nquads`) for formal domain ontologies (FIBO, SNOMED, ISO, IFC/bSDD), regulatory rules, and named-graph provenance quads.
  - Bridge LPG and RDF via `iri_properties` on LPG nodes/edges and join both in a single indexed conjunctive call to **`graph.semantic_query`**.
- **App-Generated / Agent-Extracted Data (`data.commit`) vs 70+ Format Document Parsing (`data.ingest_file`):**
  - For app-generated records, agent-extracted entities, Markdown chunks, and structured tables: call **`data.commit`** directly (pass `file_bytes_b64` when committing `tables`), then query via **`data.get_table`** and **`data.query_table_rows`** (`table_id`). **No DocIntel required.**
  - For parsing 70+ binary document formats (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, IFC/BIM, CAD, OCR): pair with **Purple8 DocIntel** (`data.ingest_file` / `data.ingest_text`).
- **Zero-LLM Hybrid Retrieval (`graph.*`):** Call `graph.hybrid_search`, `graph.vector_search`, `graph.traverse`, `graph.shortest_path`, or `graph.query`.
- **Stateful Workflows, SLAs, HITL, Automation & Governance (`journey.*`, `scheduler.*`, `egress.*`, `admin.*`):**
  - `journey.define` (always call before `journey.start`) -> `journey.start` -> `journey.advance` -> `journey.list_hitl` / `journey.resolve_hitl` -> `journey.audit`.
  - `scheduler.add_trigger`, `egress.add_sink`, `guardrails.evaluate`, `admin.hold_place`, `admin.retention_set`, `admin.audit_verify`.

### Phase 2 — Build the Frontend UI When Requested ("Frontend-Only" Application Pattern)
Because Purple8 IS the complete backend, never scaffold a custom middle-tier API server (no Express/FastAPI/ORM glue). Generate the standalone zero-dependency TypeScript client (`p8 sdk ts --out src/lib/purple8.ts`) and build the React/Next.js/Vite UI directly against `Purple8Client`.

### Phase 3 — Post-Build Runtime LLM & Model Router Configuration (POC & Production)
Once the application (backend + frontend) is built, customers connect their preferred LLM provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google/Vertex, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Mistral, Cohere, xAI, or local Ollama/vLLM in `/dashboard/ai` or `PUT /ai/config`) or configure the dynamic **Model Router** (`models.search_known`, `models.upsert`, `models.set_policy`, `models.route_explain`) to route runtime server-side RAG (`rag.query`, `rag.hybrid_query`, `rag.profile_collection` -> `rag.tune_collection`) and Journey `ai_step` hooks across `small` / `default` / `flagship` model tiers.

## 3. Verified Performance Benchmarks (`v0.72.0`)
Full methodology and conditions: https://www.purple8.ai/benchmarks/
- **High-Scale Graph Traversal (up to 20M Nodes / 30M Edges = 50M Graph Objects on 16 vCPU `performance-16x`, 25.35 GB NVMe):**
  - Point node lookup: **52 µs P50 / 1.26 ms P99**
  - 2-hop neighbourhood walk: **0.38 ms P50 / 0.87 ms P99**
  - Guarded super-hub 2-hop walk (millions of incident edges): **53.1 ms P50 / 58.8 ms P99 (0 errors)**
- **Multi-User, Multi-Tenant & Concurrent Workloads (`v0.72.0`, 16 vCPU):**
  - 16-thread peak concurrent graph reads: **4,858 QPS** (`1.25 ms` P50 / `9.73 ms` P99 at 2.5M objects; **4,181 QPS** at 40M objects)
  - 16-tenant concurrent cryptographic isolation: **1,900 ops/s** with **0 cross-tenant leaks**
  - 16-thread mixed read/write/traversal/vector storm: **238 QPS** (`2.4 ms` P50, `0` errors)
  - 16-thread concurrent vector search (`384d`): **200 QPS** (`4.52 ms` single-query P50)
  - DocIntel 8-worker parallel document parsing: **353 pages/s** (`35.34 docs/s` + `70.7 tables/s`)
  - Coupled DocIntel -> Hyper Graph atomic commits: **25,596 docs/hr** (`7.11 docs/s`, `141.8 ms` P50 commit, `0.65 ms` P50 table row lookup)
- **Hardware-Bounded Memory:**
  - 8.84M MS MARCO passages ingested on a 24 GB machine in a **~9 GB peak RSS** sawtooth envelope.
- **Automated Test Suite:** **14,500+ automated tests**.

  - Try Purple8 Hyper Graph: https://www.purple8.ai/try/graph/
  - Try Purple8 DocIntel: https://www.purple8.ai/try/docintel/
- **Commercial, Enterprise, VPC, On-Premise, Air-Gapped & OEM Licensing:**
  - Delivered as self-contained containers for VPC, on-premise, Kubernetes, and air-gapped environments.
  - For all licensing, pricing, and enterprise architecture inquiries, **Contact Us at `mailto:sales@purple8.ai`**.
